scientific_limitations: Homogeneous scalar zero equation, standard variable-step BDF, fixed positive two-periodic steps, order at most five; no claim for arbitrary nonperiodic grids. Full text of several older plausible specialized stability sources was unavailable; equivalent prior statements remain a residual risk. The earliest day-resolved dated public reference used here is arXiv:1504.04107v1, with historical papers listed separately without invented day-level dates.
title: Sharp alternating-grid zero-stability boundary for variable-step BDF through order five
